title: i made a sumo game where eggs shove each other into a hot frying pan 🍳
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
it's called Yolk Sumo. 60 seconds, one buttery pan, up to 8 friends.

touch the hot rim and you're cooked. literally LOL. your egg cracks and leaves a little yolk behind as a warning to the others.

i've lost more friendships to this than to monopoly

what's the most unhinged way you'd want to cook your friends next?

replies.body: Maybe I could’ve worded that better LOL but the heated area of the pan gets larger every 15 seconds. So you’ve got less and less space to survive in

replies.body: maybe it still works if the pan heats from inside to outside? so a hot ring in the middle is the first thing that eliminates ? i dunno
